verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal announces an official Anytype CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, so a first-party CLI exists. That is the product's own capability, but it is backed by a single one-line announcement. Nothing documents what the CLI does beyond acting as a headless server, or how it fits AI-agent workflows. missing for 10: documented CLI commands/reference, explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, install/usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
